settings.title: Settings
settings.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently deletes your player name and all your scores. This cannot be undone.
settings.privacyBody: We store only your player name and your game scores. Nothing else. No email, no ads, no data selling — ever.
settings.restartNeededBody: The app needs to restart to switch the layout direction. Please close and reopen the app.

snake.name: Snake
snake.howto: Swipe anywhere to steer the snake. Eat the food to grow. Don't hit the walls or yourself. The snake gets faster as it grows!

brickbreaker.name: Brick Breaker
brickbreaker.howto: Slide your finger to move the paddle. Bounce the ball to smash all the bricks. Hit the ball with the paddle's edge to change its angle. You have 3 balls.

paddleduel.name: Paddle Duel
paddleduel.howto: Slide your finger to move your paddle. Return the ball past the computer's paddle to score. First to 7 points wins. The rally gets faster the longer it lasts!

spacedefenders.name: Space Defenders
spacedefenders.howto: Slide your finger to move your ship — it fires automatically. Big scores upgrade your fighter with stronger cannons. Clear all three waves, then defeat the mothership to win!

memorymatch.name: Memory Match
memorymatch.howto: Tap a card to flip it, then find its matching partner. Match every pair to win. Fewer moves means a higher score. Take your time — there's no clock.

neonstack.name: Neon Stack
neonstack.howto: Drag left or right to move the falling piece, tap to spin it, and drag down to drop it faster. Fill a complete row to clear it — clear four at once for a huge bonus. The blocks fall faster as you go!

solitaire.name: Solitaire
solitaire.howto: Tap a card to move it automatically to the best spot. Build the four suit piles from Ace to King. In the columns, stack cards in descending order with alternating colors. Tap the deck to draw a new card. Take all the time you need.

roadhopper.name: Road Hopper
roadhopper.howto: Swipe to hop one step at a time. Dodge the cars on the road, then cross the river by riding the logs — never touch the water! Fill all five nests at the top to advance. Watch out: everything moves faster each round.

pixelwings.name: Pixel Wings
pixelwings.howto: Tap anywhere to flap your wings and stay in the air. Glide through the gap between the towers — one point for each tower you pass. One bump and it's over. How far can you fly?

alleybowl.name: Alley Bowl
alleybowl.howto: Drag sideways to line up your ball, then flick UP to roll — the angle of your flick curves the shot. Knock down all ten pins! Strikes and spares score bonus points, just like real bowling. Ten frames; a perfect game is 300.

tilefusion.name: Tile Fusion
tilefusion.howto: Swipe to slide all the tiles. When two matching numbers collide they fuse into one bigger number. Reach the glowing 2048 tile! The game ends when the board is full and nothing can merge. No clock — plan every move.

retroracer.name: Retro Racer
retroracer.howto: Swipe left or right to hop between the three lanes. Slip past the oncoming cars — the road gets faster and busier the farther you drive. One crash ends the run. How far can you go?

divesquadron.name: Dive Squadron
divesquadron.howto: Slide to move; your ship fires automatically. Diving enemies are worth double. Big scores upgrade your fighter — clear three waves and take down the mothership to win!

eggcatch.name: Egg Catch
eggcatch.howto: Eggs roll down four ramps and tumble off the edge. Slide your finger anywhere — the basket follows it. Catch every egg before it hits the floor; crack three and the game is over. They come faster as your score grows!

tankbattle.name: Tank Battle
tankbattle.howto: Hold a direction to drive your tank and tap ◎ to fire. Brick walls crumble, steel doesn’t. Destroy the whole enemy patrol to bring in the next, faster wave!

towerclimb.name: Tower Climb
towerclimb.howto: Walk with ◀ ▶, climb ladders with ▲ ▼, and jump barrels with ↥. Reach the ape at the top to score big — each rescue makes the barrels faster!

jungledash.name: Jungle Dash
jungledash.howto: Tap anywhere to jump. Leap over pits, logs and snakes, and grab the floating treasure mid-jump. The jungle speeds up the farther you run!

blastmaze.name: Blast Maze
blastmaze.howto: Steer with the pad and drop bombs with ◎. The blast is a cross — it clears crates and prowlers, and it hurts you too, so step away fast! Clear every prowler to advance.

chopperrescue.name: Chopper Rescue
chopperrescue.howto: Fly with the pad. Hover low over the stranded to winch them aboard (3 seats), then land on the cyan pad to drop them off. Watch the turret’s flak!

cratepush.name: Crate Push
cratepush.howto: Swipe or use the pad to walk and push crates onto the glowing targets. Crates only push — never pull — so plan ahead and use ↩ to undo a bad shove.

pixellogic.name: Pixel Logic
pixellogic.howto: The numbers show the runs of filled cells in each row and column. Tap to fill in ■ mode, or switch to ✗ to mark empties. Three wrong fills end the run!

fourstack.name: Four Stack
fourstack.howto: Tap a column to drop your disc. Line up four — across, down or diagonally — before the computer does. It gets smarter every round you win!

fruitslice.name: Fruit Slice
fruitslice.howto: Fruit flies up — swipe through it to slice! Chain several in one swipe for combo bonuses. Don’t slice the bombs, and don’t let fruit drop: three misses end the game.

skyjump.name: Sky Jump
skyjump.howto: Your critter bounces on its own — slide or use ◀ ▶ to steer it onto platforms. White ones crumble after one bounce, springs launch you high, and the screen edges wrap. Don’t fall!

blockdrop.name: Block Drop
blockdrop.howto: Steer the falling shape with ◀ ▶, spin it with ↻, slam it with ▼ (swipes work too). Fill a row to clear it — four at once for the big bonus! The well speeds up every 10 lines.

pinball.name: Pinball
pinball.howto: Tap the LEFT or RIGHT half of the screen to flip. Bumpers score 50 and the top lane 200; every 2000 points lights a multiplier. Don’t let the ball fall through the middle — three balls per game!

bubblepop.name: Bubble Pop
bubblepop.howto: Drag to aim — the dotted line bounces off the walls — and release to fire. Stick 3+ of a color together to pop them; bubbles left hanging fall for double points. The field creeps down every 6 shots!

airhockey.name: Air Hockey
airhockey.howto: Slide your finger to move the green mallet — smack the puck into the red goal at the top. The machine defends and strikes back! First to 7 goals wins the match; each match is faster.

clawmachine.name: Claw Machine
clawmachine.howto: The claw sweeps side to side — tap DROP when it’s right above a prize. A perfect center grab holds; a sloppy one can slip on the way up! Golden prizes score triple, and every win refunds a token.

poolball.name: 8-Ball Pool
poolball.howto: Drag anywhere to aim — the dots show the shot — and release to strike. Pot the colored balls (50 each), then sink the 8-ball to clear the rack for a big bonus. Sinking the cue or the 8-ball early costs a cue!

duckblast.name: Duck Blast
duckblast.howto: Ducks burst from the grass flying wild zig-zags — tap a duck to shoot it! You get 3 shells per wave. Bag 6 of every 10 ducks to reach the next, faster round… and try not to make the dog laugh.

islandkid.name: Island Kid
islandkid.howto: The kid never stops running — or getting hungry! Grab bananas before the FOOD bar empties. Jump the red rocks with ▲ and throw axes with 🪓 at snails, cobras and birds. Three lives; the island only gets faster.

username.title: Choose your player name
username.subtitle: No sign-up needed — your App Store or Google Play account is your identity. Just pick a name for the scoreboards!
